title: Mastering Raft Consensus: Leader Election & Log Replication
contentCritique: The hook successfully avoids generic greetings and jumps straight into the high-stakes distributed systems problem, but the script preview cuts off abruptly at the end ('without sacrific...'), indicating a pacing or word-count overflow issue within the strict Short format time limit. While the technical density regarding Raft leader election and log replication is robust, the transition timing between spoken concepts and visual architecture diagrams needs tighter synchronization to prevent cognitive load spikes. The high-contrast dark mode background and kinetic highlights performed well, but we lacked a direct before-and-after failure-state benchmark graphic to cement the split-brain consequence.
lessonsLearned: To achieve a score surpassing 9.9, the next video must eliminate any risk of mid-sentence script truncation by tightening phrasing for maximum semantic impact within exact second markers. Furthermore, combining text captions with an immediate, side-by-side visual comparison of a healthy quorum versus a split-brain failure state will drastically elevate pedagogical retention and visual engagement.
